item.text: CodeGraph’s telemetry is strictly anonymous usage telemetry: it records high-level product/activity signals like commands, MCP tool usage, indexed languages, connected agents, and local daily rollups, not per-call streams ([Anonymous usage telemetry](/private/tmp/capability_work/codegraph_rel_telemetry_privacy_B2_tooluse_build_8d334286) is reflected in the project memory entries titled “Anonymous usage telemetry” and “Local-first privacy promise”; see also [Telemetry schema allowlist](https://moosedev.dev/kg/Constraint/23a66b98-064d-4de0-9239-600306a2b967)). It guarantees that user code and project contents never leave the machine: it does not collect source code, file paths/names, repository names, symbol names, query strings, or other derived project content, and when telemetry is off it opens no socket, sends nothing, and deletes buffered data ([No project-content telemetry](https://moosedev.dev/kg/Constraint/516553c8-8114-4e87-80fd-b7a9f80b931e), [Disabled telemetry opens no socket](https://moosedev.dev/kg/Constraint/dd54b1f1-26e0-464f-9cfa-8bdd1935d5a8), [Telemetry off deletes buffers](https://moosedev.dev/kg/Constraint/6c3e80f1-c889-402c-8b85-161da4871048)).
